description: Air cargo unit load device (ULD) specs: LD and pallet types with their IATA codes (AKE, AKH, PMC base P6P, etc.), internal volume (m³ and ft³), height, depth and base/overall width (mm and inches), nominal width, contour and the aircraft they fit, from the ULD table on Wikipedia (CC BY-SA 4.0). Search by LD name or IATA prefix. Tare weights and maximum gross loads vary by manufacturer and are not included. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

type.description: Optional: LD name or IATA ULD code, e.g. LD3, AKE, P1P. Empty lists all.
